slug: 2025-10-26 Libya launches root servers in Tripoli and Benghazi — digital sovereignty

facts.fact: GACI announced root servers in service in Tripoli and Benghazi as implementing the National Telecommunications and Informatics Strategy 2023-2027 (Libya Herald, published 2025-10-26).
The document names the strategy as covering 2023-2027 (published 2025-10-26).
GACI, the communications and informatics authority, is the body announcing implementation of the strategy; no budget line is stated.
Implementation is claimed through the root-server launch, measured against no target of the strategy.
Root servers entered service in Tripoli and Benghazi data centres in October 2025 under the strategy; the document gives no day, so its published date is used.

systems.owner: General Authority for Communications and Informatics (GACI)
